title: Network employees receive owner-only 403 responses
original_report: After sign-in was repaired, an active employee of the Vesyolaya Raschyoska network received payment and access errors while using the Engels location.
discovery_scope: Production requests for the employee and Engels business
Business profile, token usage, and content context authorization paths
Shared business access helper and focused access tests
expected: An active network member can read the profile, token usage, and content context of an active network location.
actual: All three paths rejected the employee because they compared only owner_id.
environment: Python 3.11.7 local tests; Docker Compose production at localos.pro
reproduction: Three focused tests use a non-owner with active network membership against the real Flask routes and content context service.
failure_signal: Two HTTP 403 responses and one PermissionError instead of successful reads.
root_cause: The affected read paths implemented owner-only checks instead of the canonical verify_business_access helper that includes active network and direct business memberships.
fix_summary: Replaced the three owner-only read checks with verify_business_access while preserving not-found and unauthorized responses.
why_causal: The canonical helper resolves the same membership record that grants the employee access through auth/me, removing the inconsistent authorization decision.

reproduction_files.summary: Three employee access regressions approved at Gate 1.

fix_files.summary: Business profile read now accepts canonical employee access.
Token usage read now accepts canonical employee access.
Content context read now accepts canonical employee access.

checks.name: Regression test
checks.detail: The same three scenarios changed from red to green.

checks.name: Focused suite
checks.detail: 25 authentication, membership, and content policy tests passed.

checks.name: Production smoke
checks.detail: App is healthy, HTTP returns 200, and Irina resolves allowed=true for the Engels location.

reproduce: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_employee_business_access.py tests/test_network_member_access.py tests/test_login_business_access.py tests/test_auth_email_case_insensitive.py tests/test_content_plan_policy.py
limitations: No user session token or password was accessed, so production endpoints were not impersonated.
residual_risks: Other legacy owner-only endpoints outside the three observed read paths may require separate review.
notes: Payment and subscription records were not changed.
An existing unrelated production change in content_plan_service.py was preserved.
